cause: Nursery resolved the genesis prompt and scenario hashes before opening the run, while the separately started Gateway retained the unresolved configuration file and correctly rejected the resulting configuration-hash mismatch.
accountingLimitation: The v3 collector queried stopped services one at a time with an ambiguous Compose option form, so its terminal receipt retained no per-service observations even though the Compose transcript records all seventeen containers. The SQLite evidence contains one registered run and zero turn, ledger, or audit rows.
correctionPolicy: Retain the v3 raw receipt, logs, configuration, and SQLite database; pre-bind the exact generated prompt and scenario hashes in the shared configuration; enumerate all project containers before per-service reconciliation; and use a fresh v4 identity.
claimBoundary: This is a pre-turn application identity failure, not a behavioral result, B12 closure, or publication evidence.
